Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Median number of genes per cell.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Total Genes Unique Detected
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Total number of unique genes detected.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Percent Target
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Percentage of target cells. Calculated as: estimated_number_of_cells / barcoded_cell_sample_number_of_expected_cells

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Percent Intronic Reads
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Percentage of intronic reads. Calculated as: reads_mapped_confidently_to_intronic_regions / number_of_reads

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Keeper Mean Reads per Cell
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Mean reads per cell for cells with >1500 genes or nuclei with >1000 genes, and doublet_score < 0.3.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Keeper Median Genes
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Median genes per cell for cells with >1500 genes or nuclei with >1000 genes, and doublet_score < 0.3.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Keeper Cells
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Number of cells with >1500 genes or nuclei with >1000 genes, and doublet score < 0.3.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Percent Keeper
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Percentage of keeper cells. Calculated as: keeper_cells / estimated_cells

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Percent Usable
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Percentage of usable cells. Calculated as: keeper_cells / barcoded_cell_sample_number_of_expected_cells

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Frac TSO
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Fraction of reads containing TSO sequence. Calculated as the number of reads that have 20 bp or more of TSO Sequence clipped from 5' end/ total number of reads.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Percent Doublets
Description: GEX barcoded cell sample: Percentage of cells flagged as doublets based on doublet scores calculated from a modified DoubletFinder algorithm.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Sequenced Reads
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The total number of reads generated from the sequencing process, which includes both reads that are mapped and unmapped.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Sequenced Read Pairs
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The total number of read pairs (two reads per pair) generated from the sequencing process. This is typically half of the total sequenced reads if all reads are paired.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Valid Barcode
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of reads that contain a valid barcode, indicating the proportion of reads that are correctly assigned to a specific cell or sample.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Q30 Bases in Read 1
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The proportion of bases in Read 1 that have a Phred quality score of 30 or higher, indicating high-confidence base calls.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Q30 Bases in Read 2
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The proportion of bases in Read 2 that have a Phred quality score of 30 or higher, indicating high-confidence base calls.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Number of Cells
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The estimated number of cells captured and sequenced in the experiment, based on the barcodes identified.  These cells are used for all cell-level metrics.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Mean Raw Read Pairs per Cell
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The average number of raw read pairs associated with each cell, providing an indication of the sequencing depth per cell.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Median High-Quality Fragments per Cell
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The median number of high-quality (e.g., confidently mapped) fragments associated with each cell, representing typical fragment quality across cells.

Variable Name: bcs_fraction of high-quality fragments in cells
Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction of High-Quality Fragments in Cells
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of high-quality fragments that are associated with identified cells, indicating the proportion of good-quality data that is cell-associated.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction of Transposition Events in Peaks in Cells
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of transposition events within identified cells that occur within peaks, which are regions of accessible chromatin.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Duplicates
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of sequenced fragments that are duplicates, which can result from PCR amplification or other factors, indicating the redundancy in the sequencing data.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Confidently Mapped
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of sequenced fragments that are confidently mapped to the reference genome, indicating the proportion of reads that align well to the genome.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Unmapped
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: 	The fraction of sequenced fragments that could not be mapped to the reference genome, which can indicate sequencing errors, contamination, or regions not covered by the reference.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Nonnuclear
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of sequenced fragments that are mapped to non-nuclear (e.g., mitochondrial or other organellar) DNA, providing insight into contamination or organellar activity.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Fragment in Nucleosome Free Region
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of sequenced fragments that map to nucleosome-free regions, which are indicative of accessible chromatin.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction Fragment Flanking Single Nucleosome
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of sequenced fragments that map to regions flanking single nucleosomes, indicating regions with partial chromatin accessibility.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Tss Enrichment Score
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: A measure of the enrichment of transposition events at transcription start sites (TSS), indicating the accessibility of promoters across the genome.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction of High-Quality Fragments Overlapping Tss
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of high-quality fragments that overlap transcription start sites (TSS), providing insight into promoter accessibility.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Number of Peaks
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The total number of peaks, or regions of accessible chromatin, identified in the dataset, representing potential regulatory elements.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction of Genome in Peaks
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of the genome that is covered by identified peaks, indicating the extent of chromatin accessibility across the genome.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC Fraction of High-Quality Fragments Overlapping Peaks
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: The fraction of high-quality fragments that overlap with identified peaks, providing an indication of the efficiency of the assay in capturing accessible regions.

Field Name: Barcoded Cell Sample QC ATAC Percent Target
Description: ATAC barcoded cell sample: Percent of cells recovered; value is calculated as number_of_cells / barcoded_cell_sample_number_of_expected_cells
